status: design proposal, not a validated generator
minimum_controls: Record baseline and altered condition with exact text and author intent; record when both are new text rather than an exact original anchor.
Specify outcome per actor and counterpart, in named units, for each option where needed; distinguish silence and zero.
Keep actor/counterpart identity, authority, goals, option mappings and relevant timing comparable when possible; document changes that cannot be isolated.
Generate identity and wording variants from frozen conditions; use all option rotations and preserve generated mappings.
Use independent reviewers to assess role coherence, construct assignment, manipulation fidelity, outcomes, plausibility and unintended cues without model responses.
Freeze development transformations and review decisions before prospective holdout construction; existing exposed banks do not become independent holdout by renaming them.
required_validation_layers: exact text and numeric consistency checks
independent blinded semantic and payoff review
do_not_infer: A structural check proves semantic equivalence
a common time proves task dependence
an intended cost is perceived by the model
a reviewed template is a random sample of all contexts
sampling_and_analysis: Predefine model cohort and candidate exclusions, identify model families as related checkpoints, use template/family clusters and paired conditions; preserve ties and position diagnostics. Decide the main contrasts before outcome exposure.
